quest.title: The More Treasures the Merrier
quest.description: Marjorie seems to be upset about not having enough goods...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x3000, Mora x1000, Northern Smoked Chicken x1, Delicious Northern Smoked Chicken x1

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: This is bad... Very bad...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Traveler! Just the person I needed to see. Did you know this is my souvenir shop?

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: My dad used to wait till the adventurers came back and buy their spoils of war from them to sell in the shop.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: But since things started dying down at the Adventurers' Guild, my opportunities to stock up have been few and far between.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Not only that, but recently the items we get in are hardly worth anything. Nobody wants to buy them.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Traveler, your adventures take you all over the place, don't they? Could I trouble you to bring me back some treasures that I can sell next time?

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: Thank you! Whatever you bring me, I will make sure to get a good price for.

choices.text: Actually, Paimon is worth a pretty penny.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: I'm sorry, but nobody wants to buy that.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: My customers tend to prefer objects of the more inanimate variety.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Everything clear? Off you go then, I'll be waiting.

talks.objective: Give Marjorie the rewards collected from the hilichurls
Wait for Marjorie's business to succeed

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Hmm, I haven't given you the slightest idea of what sells well, have I? I bet you don't know what to look for.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Why don't you get me some <color=#00E1FFFF>loot from the hilichurls</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: I have a feeling that adventurers looking to prove their worth would be interested in that sort of thing.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Don't forget, you're looking for some <color=#00E1FFFF>loot from the hilichurls</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Hehehe, I'm going to make me a nice stack of Mora off this...

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: This will make a handsome sum.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Wait till I've sold this and I'll be sure to compensate you fairly.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Look at that! Someone's taking an interest...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: What's this?

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Welcome! You have fine taste my friend, you've zeroed in on the most valuable item we have in the store.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: This is a battle trophy seized from the hand of a hilichurl chief not long ago, by none other than this traveler here!

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Who knows how long that frightful hilichurl hooligan has been menacing Mondstadt...

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: And don't think that just because this traveler is a seasoned warrior, it wasn't a fiercely fought battle!

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Really, wow... Sounds like this hilichurl was a nasty piece of work...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: ...Maybe I should get this and show it to Cyrus. Or Stanley.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Perhaps they'd see me differently then...

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Oh, most certainly! We know how to keep a secret in this store, don't you worry...

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: My advice would be to take it now, or someone else is sure to snatch it up before long.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: I need to think about it... Traveler — is it true what she says?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Every last word.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Well, I guess that decides it then. I'll take it!

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Excellent choice sir, if I do say so myself! Here, I've wrapped it up for you. Have a wonderful day!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Actually it's just ordinary hilichurl garbage...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Really? What would I want to buy that for?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Whew... I almost handed over the cash too! In future, spare me the hard sell and just give me the facts!

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: I'm going to look elsewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: (Test) Really? You're going to take it?

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: (Test) We have a sale!

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: I appreciate what you did back there, traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: If it wasn't for you, I probably would have wasted a lot of money in that store.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Take these. You deserve them.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Why didn't you play along!? You have to do a bit of legwork to sell basic rubbish like this...

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: How often do I get a customer in here... You're unbelievable! You realize that if you screw this up for me, we both lose out, right!?

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Ugh, forget it. Take these and get outta here, you're bad for business!

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Good job backing me up just now!

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Now, here's what I owe you... plus a bit extra for the sterling performance.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: It's been a pleasure working with you. I look forward to doing this again!
